clips.send: Someone who's paid for a guided visualization sends this to a friend eyeing the pricier 'accelerator' version: anger at realizing it's the same trick with a bigger price tag.
clips.caption:
Comment BRAIN and I'll send you Kevin's free audios.

Kevin Trudeau says there's a guy he calls Guru Jo So who'll close your eyes and walk you through a "guided meditation" you paid $500 for. Want it to really work? There's an "accelerator" version for $1,000.

What they're actually doing, Kevin says, isn't meditation. Counting backwards on an elevator, picturing yourself somewhere safe - that's hypnosis with a better marketing budget.

Real meditation needs no script, no guru, no price tag. Just sit still and come back to your breath.

Have you ever paid for a "technique" you could've done for free?
